verdict.rationale: Each skill ships its own SKILL.md with a clear description of what it does (review, qa, ship, cso, autoplan, upgrade, learn), and docs/skills.md gives a catalog of skill purposes. Activation is only partly documented: a router skill sends requests to the right skill, domain skills are injected for matching hosts, and failure learnings are logged automatically at session end. missing for 10: explicit per-skill activation triggers or 'when to use' conditions, evidence that every skill documents its activation, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agent behavior is predictable from the docs.
